description: Überschwemmungsgebiete im Land Bremen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi2.geo.bremen.de. Areas that are flooded once in a hundred years or less in the event of a flood of probability of occurrence (according to §76 WHG). Under the following link is the INSPIRE-compliant data set "No. 16, Floodplain-DE (Flood Risk Management Directive 2. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains in the state of Bremen" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include ENVI, inspireidentifiziert, Wasser, Risikogebiete, Überschwemmungsgebiete, opendata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
